BEGIN;
WITH candidates AS (
 SELECT id FROM public.tender_agentic_jobs
 WHERE status IN ('ready','running','validating')
   AND dispatch_execution_id IS NULL
   AND (poll_owner_execution_id IS NULL OR poll_claimed_at < now() - interval '5 minutes')
 ORDER BY coalesce(heartbeat_at,created_at),id
 FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
 LIMIT 2
), claimed AS (
 UPDATE public.tender_agentic_jobs j
 SET poll_owner_execution_id=$1::text,poll_claimed_at=now(),updated_at=now()
 FROM candidates c WHERE j.id=c.id
 RETURNING j.id,j.analysis_run_id,j.pipeline_version,j.replicate_index,j.status,j.field_catalog_version,
 j.field_catalog_sha256,j.input_manifest_sha256,j.poll_owner_execution_id,j.error_code
)
SELECT * FROM claimed;
COMMIT;

WITH attempted AS (
 UPDATE public.tender_agentic_jobs SET heartbeat_at=now(),
 input_tokens=coalesce(($3::jsonb->>'input_tokens')::bigint,input_tokens),cached_input_tokens=coalesce(($3::jsonb->>'cached_input_tokens')::bigint,cached_input_tokens),
 output_tokens=coalesce(($3::jsonb->>'output_tokens')::bigint,output_tokens),reasoning_output_tokens=coalesce(($3::jsonb->>'reasoning_output_tokens')::bigint,reasoning_output_tokens),
 artifacts=artifacts||$4::jsonb,poll_owner_execution_id=NULL,poll_claimed_at=NULL,updated_at=now()
 WHERE id=$1::uuid AND poll_owner_execution_id=$2::text AND status IN ('ready','running','validating')
 RETURNING id,status
)
SELECT CASE WHEN count(*)=1 THEN 'updated' ELSE 'ownership_lost' END outcome,count(*)::int update_count,
 coalesce(max(id::text)::uuid,$1::uuid) job_id,max(status) status FROM attempted;

WITH attempted AS (
 UPDATE public.tender_agentic_jobs SET status='failed',dispatch_execution_id=NULL,attempts=$5::smallint,
 error_code=left($3::text,80),error_message=left($4::text,500),
 input_tokens=coalesce(($6::jsonb->>'input_tokens')::bigint,input_tokens),cached_input_tokens=coalesce(($6::jsonb->>'cached_input_tokens')::bigint,cached_input_tokens),
 output_tokens=coalesce(($6::jsonb->>'output_tokens')::bigint,output_tokens),reasoning_output_tokens=coalesce(($6::jsonb->>'reasoning_output_tokens')::bigint,reasoning_output_tokens),
 artifacts=artifacts||$7::jsonb,validation_summary=validation_summary||jsonb_build_object('runner_status','failed','runner_retryable',$8::boolean,'runner_attempt',$5::smallint),
 poll_owner_execution_id=NULL,poll_claimed_at=NULL,updated_at=now()
 WHERE id=$1::uuid AND poll_owner_execution_id=$2::text AND status IN ('ready','running','validating')
 AND $5::smallint BETWEEN 1 AND 2
 RETURNING id,status,error_code
)
SELECT CASE WHEN count(*)=1 THEN 'updated' ELSE 'ownership_lost' END outcome,count(*)::int update_count,
 coalesce(max(id::text)::uuid,$1::uuid) job_id,max(status) status,max(error_code) error_code FROM attempted;

WITH attempted AS (
 UPDATE public.tender_agentic_jobs SET
 validation_summary=validation_summary||jsonb_build_object('last_monitor_error',jsonb_build_object('code',left($3::text,80),'message',left($4::text,500),'at',now())),
 poll_owner_execution_id=NULL,poll_claimed_at=NULL,updated_at=now()
 WHERE id=$1::uuid AND poll_owner_execution_id=$2::text AND status IN ('ready','running','validating')
 RETURNING id,status
)
SELECT 'MONITOR_RELEASE' audit_kind,CASE WHEN count(*)=1 THEN 'updated' ELSE 'ownership_lost' END outcome,count(*)::int update_count,
 coalesce(max(id::text)::uuid,$1::uuid) job_id,max(status) status FROM attempted;

WITH attempted AS (
 UPDATE public.tender_agentic_jobs SET status='running',attempts=$3::smallint,error_code=NULL,error_message=NULL,heartbeat_at=now(),
 validation_summary=validation_summary||jsonb_build_object('start_reconciled',true,'runner_attempt',$3::smallint),
 poll_owner_execution_id=NULL,poll_claimed_at=NULL,updated_at=now()
 WHERE id=$1::uuid AND poll_owner_execution_id=$2::text AND status='ready' AND error_code='START_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN'
 AND $3::smallint BETWEEN 1 AND 2
 RETURNING id,status,attempts
)
SELECT CASE WHEN count(*)=1 THEN 'updated' ELSE 'ownership_lost' END outcome,count(*)::int update_count,
 coalesce(max(id::text)::uuid,$1::uuid) job_id,max(status) status,max(attempts)::int attempts FROM attempted;
